description: This source file defines the EcsClient class for interacting with Amazon ECS. It extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for various Amazon ECS operations, including creating, describing, updating, and deleting resources related to ECS.

classes.name: EcsClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon ECS API interactions, extending the AwsClient base class and annotated with methods for ECS operations.

methods.name: createCapacityProvider
methods.description: Creates a new capacity provider in ECS.

methods.name: createTaskSet
methods.description: Creates a new task set within a service.

methods.name: deleteAccountSetting
methods.description: Deletes an account setting in ECS.

methods.name: deleteTaskDefinitions
methods.description: Deletes one or more task definitions.

methods.name: deregisterContainerInstance
methods.description: Deregisters a container instance from ECS.

methods.name: describeClusters
methods.description: Describes one or more ECS clusters.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Describes one or more ECS services.

methods.name: discoverPollEndpoint
methods.description: Discovers the Amazon ECS service endpoint.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command on a container.

methods.name: putAccountSettingDefault
methods.description: Resets an account setting to default.

methods.name: registerContainerInstance
methods.description: Registers an EC2 or Fargate container instance.

methods.name: runTask
methods.description: Runs a task on the specified cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterSettings
methods.description: Modifies the settings for a cluster.

methods.name: updateContainerAgent
methods.description: Updates the agent on a container instance.

methods.name: updateContainerInstancesState
methods.description: Modifies the state of container instances.

methods.name: updateServicePrimaryTaskSet
methods.description: Modifies the primary task set for a service.
